baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative object at word 2, the relational title at word 3, and the dual denial verb at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal establishes a giver-recipient relation; lordship makes the gifts administered rather than ownerless; declaring them false converts recognition into an answerable dual act.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the concrete object placed under interrogation.
Ownership and authority make the favors relationally attributable to the addressed pair's Lord.
Attributing falsehood turns the dual response into an active verdict on the gifts and their giver.

changed_reading.before: A generic rhetorical question about blessings.
changed_reading.after: A dual accounting summons: identify which administered bestowal you are actively ruling false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same favor noun and Lord-title, with the split ر ب ب inventory's completion and growth branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord is read as one who repairs, completes, feeds, and grows a thing stage by stage. An ala is therefore not only a finished possession but the sustaining process by which a capacity reaches fruit; denial treats an ongoing yield as though it had failed.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal anchors the process model in the verse's ordinary gift sense.
Stagewise repair and completion recast lordship as continuous cultivation.
The non-dominant growth branch supplies nourishment and maturation as the motion of the gift.
A yield that disappears or fails expectation images denial as misreading interrupted provision as no provision.

changed_reading.before: Favors are static items already delivered.
changed_reading.after: Favors include the Lord's still-running work of repair, nourishment, maturation, and renewed yield.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2's oath branch, word 3's pact branch, and word 4's charge-that-proves-or-fails branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: Three focus-only branches align as binding speech, covenantal lordship, and a charge tested by performance. The question can therefore carry a forensic underside: which binding benefaction will the pair fail to substantiate in action?

activation_trace.role: The oath branch gives the favor-word a distant but visible binding-speech resonance.
A protective pact turns the Lord-recipient relation into a covenantal frame.
A charge that either carries through or fails supplies the behavioral test of the covenant.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only an incorrect statement.
changed_reading.after: Denial may be a failed covenantal performance that makes a received charge prove false in the pair's conduct.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of word 2 to following sequence and answering voice, joined to the dual second-person verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-dominant mapped root makes the utterance itself audible as one voice following another. The verse can operate as a response slot, not merely as a sentence carrying information.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies the refrain's serial placement after a prior unit.
A voice answering a preceding voice supplies an antiphonal mechanism for the dual question.
Acting without delay sharpens the question into a prompt for an immediate response.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a self-contained proposition repeated for emphasis.
changed_reading.after: The verse is an antiphonal turn whose placement asks the addressed pair to answer what the preceding scene has just voiced.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The non-dominant remainder and liability branches at word 2 remain attached to the Lord's ownership and the act of repudiation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A received good leaves a remainder: a claim, liability, or response that follows its holder. The question can thus ask not only which gift is denied, but which residual claim generated by the gift is being repudiated.

activation_trace.role: What remains after what came before supplies a residue carried from the prior scene into the refrain.
A right or liability following its holder converts received favor into an unresolved claim.
Lordship identifies whose claim follows the recipients.
Repudiation supplies the attempted refusal of that trailing claim.

changed_reading.before: The question points backward only to benefits already named.
changed_reading.after: The question also carries forward the unanswered liability that each received benefit leaves with its recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy initiates teaching; recitation gathers; knowledge becomes disclosed; البيان makes meaning distinguishable. Denial at 55:21 is therefore not aimed at opaque gifts but at gifts delivered together with a faculty and language for recognizing them.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal remains the object whose recognizability is at stake.
Declaring false is reclassified as resistance to supplied disclosure.
Tender mercy supplies the initiating disposition behind the sequence of disclosure.
Disclosure to a knower makes recognition an explicit operation rather than an accidental inference.
Gathering and collection make dispersed signs available as an intelligible whole.
Meaning revealed by speech or sign supplies the human capacity to articulate what has been given.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 orders mercy, teaching, creating, and teaching expression before any refrain appears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies mercy, disclosure, gathering, and expressive clarification; I infer that these jointly make recognition an intended capacity. A live alternative is that they are separate favors without a causal epistemic sequence.

changed_reading.before: The pair may simply lack evidence for the favors.
changed_reading.after: The pair is questioned about denying favors that arrive with their own pedagogy, signs, and means of articulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculation, just balance, boundary-excess, and short measure form an operational truth regime. تكذبان can now mean making the gift-system false in practice by overrunning or under-reporting its measure, not merely uttering a false proposition.

activation_trace.role: The favors become the measured goods and order subjected to the pair's conduct.
A charge that succeeds or fails lets conduct verify or falsify the claimed order.
Counting and reckoning supply the cosmos with determinate measure.
A balance of justice makes right proportion the governing norm.
Exceeding the limit supplies the positive act that violates the measure.
Shorting a measure supplies the inverse distortion: making the received order practically untrue.

structural_cues: 55:5-9 moves from cosmic calculation to a human imperative not to exceed or diminish the balance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies calculation, just balance, overrun, and short measure; I infer that behavioral distortion is a mode of تكذيب. The live alternative keeps cosmic order and verbal denial as adjacent but non-causal themes.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a statement about whether favors exist.
changed_reading.after: Denial also occurs when the pair's measuring practice overruns or shorts the very order received as favor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sheath, germinating grain, chaff, and aromatic leaf present provision as a layered transformation system. The favor includes enclosure, waste-like residue, and scent as well as edible yield; the Lord's nurture works through hidden packaging and release.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal anchors the layered ecological system as favor.
The plant-name branch keeps the exploratory botanical activation visibly attached to the focus word.
Stagewise cultivation supplies the process joining enclosure to mature yield.
A plant's enclosing vessel supplies protected latency rather than immediately visible fruit.
A seed that sprouts and bears makes latent multiplication part of the gift.
Husk and broken leaf preserve the supporting residue usually excluded from a gift inventory.
A fragrant plant layer adds dispersed sensory benefit to the material yield.

structural_cues: 55:11-12 inventories fruit, palm enclosures, grain, chaff, and fragrance immediately before the first refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies nested plant parts and process branches; I infer that their enclosure-to-yield relation, not only each item, is the favor. A live alternative reads them as a flat produce list.

changed_reading.before: A favor is the consumable product at the end of growth.
changed_reading.after: A favor can be the whole latent architecture of covering, seed, residue, fragrance, and maturation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Three exact pre-focus recurrences enact the non-dominant following-voice branch. At 55:21 the listener no longer hears a fresh question; the line carries accumulated unanswered turns and rehearses a dual response rhythm.

activation_trace.role: The focus word's answering-voice branch supplies the antiphonal baseline.
The first recurrence makes a voice follow the opening creation and provision sequence.
The second recurrence materializes a responding voice after the paired origins.
The third recurrence establishes serial expectation immediately before the sea scene.

structural_cues: 55:13, 55:16, and 55:18 repeat the complete focus formula before 55:21.
The dual suffixes keep two addressees inside every response slot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies exact recurrence plus sequence and answering-voice branches; I infer a call-response performance. A live alternative treats repetition as a non-dialogic rubric whose only function is emphasis.

changed_reading.before: 55:21 asks its question once after the barrier scene.
changed_reading.after: 55:21 is the fourth accumulated response turn, so silence or denial itself becomes part of the performed exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: Resonant dry clay and mobile flame give the dual addressees sharply different material origins. The one refrain makes both media co-witness the same benefaction while preserving their difference.

activation_trace.role: An answering voice supplies a common response form for materially unlike addressees.
Dry clay defined by resonance gives one addressee a bounded, sounding material origin.
A mobile tongue of flame gives the other addressee a contrasting fluid and energetic origin.
Kindled fire sharpens the energetic pole of the created pair.

structural_cues: 55:14 and 55:15 place the two creations in parallel clauses, followed by the dual refrain at 55:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies opposed material images and dual grammar; I infer that the refrain makes the two created kinds answer as co-witnesses. The live alternative is only the straightforward naming of human and jinn origins.

changed_reading.before: The dual address is a grammatical fact with no mechanism.
changed_reading.after: The dual address convenes materially different witnesses in one answering form without erasing their difference.

context_deltas.mechanism: Release creates motion, encounter brings opposed bodies together, the interval preserves distinction, and non-overrun keeps either side from consuming the other. The barrier is itself an ala because restraint makes sustained meeting possible.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal allows a limit, not only a substance, to count as favor.
Free release supplies the motion that requires a preserving constraint.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies genuine contact rather than isolation.
Separation preserves the identity of the meeting sides.
Overrunning a limit supplies the destructive alternative that the barrier prevents.

structural_cues: 55:19 gives release and meeting; 55:20 inserts a middle barrier and negates mutual overrun; 55:21 immediately names the arrangement as an ala.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies motion, encounter, separation, and non-overrun; I infer that the limit causes durable coexistence. A live alternative treats the barrier as a display of power rather than an enabling condition.

changed_reading.before: The favor is the existence of two seas.
changed_reading.after: The favor is a preserving limit that lets opposed expanses meet without either erasing the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: A competing reading keeps the barrier from becoming only a wall. The middle can be both interval and relation; it joins the sides precisely by regulating their mixture. The ala is an interface that carries contact across difference.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal anchors the enabling interface as the favor under question.
Mixture and disturbance supply pressure toward interaction rather than sealed separation.
Making two ends meet supplies an active joining operation.
The interval between two things locates the interface in a real middle.
A connection standing between parties lets the same middle mediate relation.

structural_cues: The two seas are explicitly meeting, so the intervening barzakh occurs inside contact rather than outside it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies meeting, mixture, interval, and inter-party connection; I infer that regulation can transmit relation as well as block overrun. The live alternative is the preserving-boundary model, where connection is incidental and separation does the causal work.

changed_reading.before: The barrier's value lies only in keeping entities apart.
changed_reading.after: The barrier may be a connective middle that enables exchange while preserving non-identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus question, concealed value comes out from the paired waters as pearl and coral. The location of 55:21 becomes a suspense hinge: it names the relational system a favor before its latent product becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: The favor-word names the paired system before its output is disclosed.
Cultivation and completion provide a process model for value emerging from relation.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition from latent to manifest value.
Gleaming emergence makes the previously hidden output perceptible.
The coral branch locates a second valued product on the same lexical field that earlier supplied release and mixture.

structural_cues: 55:21 stands between the non-overrunning encounter of 55:19-20 and the emergence from both in 55:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies a paired system followed by concealed value coming out; I infer that relation under constraint enables the output. A live alternative treats 55:22 as an independent inventory item rather than the result of the preceding mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The question merely sums up a completed sea description.
changed_reading.after: The question pauses over a still-latent gift whose precious output becomes visible only in the next verse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later antithesis of universal passing and the remaining Face activates the focus word's non-dominant remainder and following-liability branches. Each refrain can carry a residue from what passes: the Lord's surviving claim on how a transient favor was answered.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following what preceded anchors the focus in residual rather than merely present value.
A right that follows its holder turns residue into continuing accountability.
Cessation after persistence supplies the passing side of the contrast.
What remains from a thing directly activates the residual reading.
Face as self locates enduring remainder in the Lord rather than in transient objects.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 forms an all-pass versus Lord-remains antithesis before another exact refrain.
The branchless root ج ل ل at 55:27 intensifies the remaining side but is used only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies passing, remainder, enduring self, and the focus split-root branches; I infer that a gift leaves a claim after its form passes. The live alternative is a simple temporal contrast with no transfer of remainder into 55:21.

changed_reading.before: An ala lasts only as long as its perceptible object.
changed_reading.after: Even a passing ala can leave a surviving claim that follows the recipients back to the enduring Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal asking meets a Lord active in every temporal unit, with the branch of repairing and perfecting work. This confirms that favors are live responses and maintenance events, not a closed historical stock.

activation_trace.role: Continuous repair and completion anchor lordship as active maintenance.
Bestowal receives a durative rather than merely completed aspect.
Request and seeking supply the incoming need to which provision responds.
A temporal duration distributes lordly action continuously rather than once.
Repairing and doing work well specifies the active quality of each renewed response.

structural_cues: 55:29 places all asking beings opposite an every-day divine activity, followed immediately by the refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies request, recurring time, and repaired work; I infer a request-response maintenance cycle. A live alternative reads daily شأن as sovereign variety without linking it causally to the askers' needs.

changed_reading.before: The pair reviews a fixed archive of past favors.
changed_reading.after: The pair is inside a present-tense economy in which need and lordly repair renew the favor continuously.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired heavy communities are invited to pass the cosmic sides yet cannot cross except with compelling authorization. The sea barrier model scales into jurisdiction: a limit can be traversable, but only through granted capacity and valid authority.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies the authority under which boundaries and permissions are administered.
Capacity at the focus word becomes a distant resonance with enabled or blocked passage.
Weight supplies the paired communities with resistance to unrestricted escape.
Passing cleanly to the other side defines the attempted boundary crossing.
Sides and extremities spatialize the jurisdiction being tested.
Compelling warrant supplies the condition under which passage becomes valid.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats the passage verb three times and makes authority the sole exception to inability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies paired weight, sides, crossing, and warrant; I infer that the earlier limit is jurisdictional as well as material. A live alternative treats the later challenge as unrelated eschatological confinement.

changed_reading.before: A favor is freedom from limits.
changed_reading.after: A favor may be a governed limit together with the real, non-self-generated authority by which passage is possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, acquired wrongdoing becomes recognizable through marks, and the denied object is named again. False attribution does not remain detachable speech; repeated denial writes a legible verdict onto the denier.

activation_trace.role: Declaring something false anchors the trajectory in the focus act of denial.
Recognition by an effect or sign supplies the later legibility of conduct.
Acquisition makes the identifying state something accumulated through action.
A visible mark makes the acquired verdict inspectable without further questioning.
The later explicit denial reconnects the marked outcome to the refrain's repeated verb.

structural_cues: 55:39 says no one is questioned, 55:41 says the guilty are recognized by marks, and 55:43 names what they had denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies acquired wrongdoing, visible marks, recognition, and repeated denial; I infer a causal inscription from conduct to verdict. A live alternative is instantaneous divine identification with no self-inscribing process.

changed_reading.before: Denial can remain an unobservable verbal stance.
changed_reading.after: Denial is a repeated practice that eventually becomes its own visible evidence and answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two gardens contain two flowing springs and every fruit in pairs. This later nested pairing echoes the two seas and the dual addressees, making twoness a productive grammar: relation multiplies habitats, flows, and kinds.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal anchors productive pairing as the favor being recognized.
Cultivation and completion supply the generative action within each pair.
A garden hidden by dense growth supplies a cultivated paired habitat.
A flowing water source supplies each habitat with generative circulation.
Continuous flow turns the paired sources into active provision.
One counterpart joined to another makes pairing explicit at the level of every fruit.

structural_cues: The dual forms at 55:46, 55:50, and 55:52 nest pairs inside pairs and are each separated by the same dual refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies nested duals, sources, flow, and paired kinds; I infer that pairing itself generates abundance. A live alternative treats grammatical duals as descriptive symmetry without productive causality.

changed_reading.before: The two in 55:21 are merely two recipients asked the same question.
changed_reading.after: The pair form mirrors a larger ecology in which held difference and coupling repeatedly generate abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later furnishings expose their value through inner lining, while harvest is brought near. This sharpens the latent-product model: an ala may reside inside a structure before it is accessible, and denial can result from judging only the exterior.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal anchors concealed interior value as favor rather than mere hiddenness.
Earlier emergence from concealment supplies the transition this later interior repeats.
The inside of a thing locates value beneath its visible surface.
Taking harvest from its growth-site supplies realized yield.
Nearness makes latent yield accessible without erasing its prior concealment.

structural_cues: 55:54 juxtaposes unseen inner lining with harvest made near, after 55:22 has already staged emergence from concealment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies interior, extraction, and nearness; I infer a hidden-to-accessible gift process. A live alternative treats lining and fruit as unrelated luxury details.

changed_reading.before: Only immediately visible benefits can answer the question at 55:21.
changed_reading.after: The question includes value still held inside a system and asks for trustful recognition before or as it becomes accessible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later rhetorical equation of good action with its answering good supplies an ethical reply to the refrain. Recognition is not only assent; received benefaction calls for a corresponding beautiful act, so denial is failed reciprocity.

activation_trace.role: Received benefaction supplies the first side of the reciprocal relation.
An answering voice supplies the response form later filled by ethical return.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies reciprocity's directional structure.
Doing what is good fills both sides of the reciprocal equation with enacted excellence.

structural_cues: 55:60 is itself an interrogative equation and is immediately followed by the exact refrain at 55:61.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies benefaction, answering sequence, recompense, and good action; I infer that acknowledgment should take ethical form. A live alternative keeps 55:60 restricted to reward after deeds rather than a model for answering gifts.

changed_reading.before: The expected answer to 55:21 is verbal admission.
changed_reading.after: The expected answer can be reciprocal ihsan: a received good made truthful through a corresponding good act.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gushing water, chosen good, flourishing green life, and fixed growing blessing converge on a regenerative reading of ala. The closing blessing does not merely label abundance; it describes good that remains planted while continuing to increase.

activation_trace.role: Nourishing growth anchors the Lord-title in a regenerative process.
Bestowal names the outputs of that process as favors.
Abundant upwelling water supplies renewable input rather than a finite store.
Selected excellence supplies qualitative flourishing, not mere quantity.
Fresh flourishing life supplies the experiential state produced by regeneration.
Good that stays rooted while growing supplies the closure's durable increase.

structural_cues: The closing verse returns to the Lord-title after repeated water, fruit, and green-life scenes.
The branchless root ج ل ل at 55:78 frames the closure structurally but is not assigned a mapped root or branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies upwelling, selected good, flourishing life, and stable increase; I infer a regenerative circuit under nurturing lordship. A live alternative reads these as independent paradise descriptors plus a conventional closing blessing.

changed_reading.before: An ala is a finite unit transferred from giver to recipient.
changed_reading.after: An ala can be a rooted regenerative capacity whose good persists by continuing to rise, flow, and fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The plant-name activation is surprising because it is not the surface sense of ءالاء; it remains valid as a packet branch at the exact focus word and is reinforced by the focus verb's deceptive-surface branch. Downstream prose should present it only as a sensory analogy: some gifts may look attractive yet taste difficult, without replacing 'favors' with a plant name.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 carries a branch for a handsome but bitter shrub, while word 4 carries a branch for cloth whose appearance misleads.

activation_trace.role: A visually pleasing but bitter plant supplies tension between attractive appearance and difficult reception.
A surface whose pattern deceives supplies the risk of judging gift-status by appearance alone.

changed_reading.before: A genuine favor must be immediately pleasant in every register.
changed_reading.after: The question may also test whether difficult taste or ambiguous appearance is being mistaken for absence of favor.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because ability and falling short are neighboring root branches, not the ordinary noun sense in context. It remains anchored by two exact focus branches and by the charge-success branch of تكذبان. Downstream prose should frame it as a secondary activation about response-capacity, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 activates both capacity and shortfall; word 4 can describe whether a charge is carried through.

activation_trace.role: Achieved capacity supplies what the recipients have been enabled to do.
Falling short supplies the recipients' failure to exercise that capacity fully.
A charge that fails in execution turns shortfall into practical falsification.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks only what external gifts the pair rejects.
changed_reading.after: It may also ask at which gifted capacity the pair falls short and thereby lets its entrusted charge fail.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The last-breath image is highly surprising and comes through the non-dominant split mapping, so it cannot control the verse. It remains inspectable at the exact focus word and gains contextual pressure from passing versus remaining at 55:26-27. Downstream prose should qualify it as an eschatological echo: the unanswered claim may follow to the final breath.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2 has a split-root branch for the last breath and another for a remainder after what preceded.

activation_trace.role: The final breath supplies an extreme temporal endpoint for the refrain's following claim.
A remainder after prior events supplies what persists to that endpoint.
Passing away after duration makes the endpoint contextually live.
Continuance supplies the counter-pole that keeps a claim present when created forms end.

changed_reading.before: Each recurrence expires when its local scene ends.
changed_reading.after: An unanswered recurrence may trail the recipients through every passing scene, even to the last breath.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain textile activation is unusually exact but semantically dangerous: focus تكذيب has a deceptive patterned-cloth branch, while 55:76's luxury textile root carries both fine patterned rugs and pure falsehood. It remains valid because every step is branch-backed at the cited words. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy about splendor and evidence, never claim that the verse lexically means cloth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial verb has a branch for a variegated cloth that misrepresents its condition.

activation_trace.role: A patterned surface that deceives anchors truth-testing in material appearance.
Bestowal keeps the appearance problem tied to evaluating a gift.
Rare patterned furnishings supply the concrete luxury surface under inspection.
The same context root's pure-falsehood branch makes splendor and deceptive claim coexist at one occurrence.

changed_reading.before: Visible splendor is self-authenticating evidence of favor.
changed_reading.after: The refrain may stage a truth test in which patterned splendor can disclose gift or tempt a surface-based misjudgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The failed-milk branch of تكذيب is idiomatic and agrarian, so it is too distant for a primary reading. It remains anchored at the focus verb and gains a real process contrast from later continuous flow and abundant upwelling. Downstream prose should use it only to describe fluctuating versus renewed yield, not to translate denial as milk failure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 4 has a branch for milk disappearing instead of lasting as expected; word 3 carries nurture and post-birth freshness branches.

activation_trace.role: Yield that unexpectedly disappears supplies a material model of disappointed provision.
Post-birth freshness and milk-provision keep the outlier inside a nurtured-yield field.
Ongoing provision supplies the expected continuity against which interruption is judged.
Abundant upwelling supplies renewal after apparent depletion.

changed_reading.before: Any interruption in supply proves that provision was false.
changed_reading.after: The refrain may expose the mistake of treating a fluctuating yield as failed nurture when the larger system renews its flow.

strongest_changes: 55:5-9 turns denial from mere speech into practical falsification through overrun or short measure.
55:19-20 makes a preserving boundary itself a favor, while a coexisting reading treats the middle as a connective interface.
55:22 makes 55:21 a suspense hinge that names a paired system before its latent precious output emerges.
Exact recurrence activates the split-root sequence and answering-voice branches, so the verse performs an accumulated response turn.
Later passing, remaining, visible marks, reciprocity, and regenerative closure keep residual, ethical, and process readings alive beside the ordinary benefaction reading.
summary.what_was_special: The focus line is simultaneously a stable refrain and a highly permeable hinge. Its dominant branches support bestowed favor under nurturing lordship and active denial; split and material branches open covenant, response, remainder, capacity, bitter beauty, failed yield, and deceptive textile models. Its position between non-overrunning encounter and concealed value emerging makes multiple causal readings coexist without requiring one final disambiguation.
remaining_uncertainties: The oath, capacity, remainder, last-breath, and answering-voice readings depend on branch-distant or non-dominant mappings and must remain exploratory.
The packet supports both barrier-as-preserving-limit and barrier-as-connective-interface; the direction of causality is reader-supplied in both.
It is uncertain whether later scenes retroactively specify 55:21 or merely create resonant re-readings of a locally complete refrain.
The dual grammar strongly sustains paired mechanisms, but the exact relation between the two addressees is not resolved by the focus line alone.
